{{No footnotes|date=March 2022}}
'''Firefly''' is a U.S. [[National Security Agency]] [[public-key cryptography|public-key]] [[key exchange]] protocol, used in [[EKMS]], the [[STU-III]] secure telephone, and several other U.S. cryptographic systems.
